sections.heading: How to interpret it
paragraphs: A summit declaration can offer political direction, but its practical effect normally depends on the commitments, benchmarks and implementation arrangements it contains. Those details are unavailable in the supplied source record.
A common misconception is to treat the existence of a declaration as proof of a completed policy outcome. The available evidence does not support that conclusion.
